title: Golden workbook requires retaining dimensionally invalid balance-sheet totals
evidence: The instruction says to audit and fix the file 'thoroughly,' including formula logic errors and unit inconsistencies, but the golden workbook preserves erroneous totals from the input. Model!E59 is '=SUM(E51:E53,E55,E57)', which adds E52 ('Days Unbilled Outstanding') to monetary balances. Its expected value is 245.121412232908, although the monetary components total 137.738; the excess is exactly 107.383412232908 days. This error repeats through N59. Likewise, E67:N67 include the percentage on row 62 in monetary liability totals. Correcting these total formulas while retaining the golden workbook's other fixes produces a modification ratio of 0.9667, including mismatches in I68:N68. The sole verifier has weight 1 and requires a modification ratio of 1.0, so this legitimate thorough-audit correction receives zero credit.
